plotEn: Vikrant Thapar works for the CTS squad who keep an eye on terrorist activities being planned against India. In reality Vikrant is an undercover Pakistani spy sending secret information to his country to General Mir and Niyazi. He is not the only one but his fellow officer and friend Ashfaque and servant Tariq also operate with him. CTS chief Burman gets suspicious about Vikrant and Ashfaque and during a scuffle their car meets with accident. Burman is left in comatose state while Vikrant looses his memory. After Vikrant recovers and joins his duty he manages to break all secret networks of Pakistan in India and his mission is to catch Bilal. But due to memory loss he isn't aware that he himself is Bilal.
